  • 运动中可穿戴传感器步态分析的临床应用：损伤预防与康复的系统综述 [IF 3.4 (JCR 2024) · 康复医学2区/运动科学3区 · Open Access]
    Clinical applications of wearable sensor-based gait analysis in athletes: a systematic review for injury prevention and rehabilitation
    BMC Sports Science Medicine and Rehabilitation · 2026

    一句话结论：Evaluating the clinical efficacy of wearable sensor–based gait analysis for injury prevention in athletes, examining its role in rehabilitation monitoring and clinical decision-making, and identifying methodological limitations and future research priorities required for standardized clinical integration identifies key challenges.

    步态分析是优化运动员表现和降低运动医学中损伤风险的基础。传统实验室评估提供了见解，但可穿戴传感器技术的出现为在生态有效环境中进行客观、实时步态评估提供了新机遇。本系统综述旨在 (1) 评估基于可穿戴传感器的步态分析在运动员损伤预防中的临床疗效，(2) 考察其在康复监测和临床决策中的作用，以及 (3) 识别方法学局限性和未来研究方向。…

    Effects of Plyometric Training on Physical Fitness Attributes in Handball Players: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
    Journal of Sports Sciences · 2024

    一句话结论：In conclusion, plyometric training effectively improves various physical fitness attributes, including jump performance, linear sprint ability, maximal strength, muscle power and agility.

    本荟萃分析旨在考察增强式训练对手球运动员身体素质属性的影响。通过对 PubMed、SCOPUS、SPORTDiscus 和 Web of Science 进行系统文献检索，共识别出20项研究，涉及563名运动员。增强式训练对多项属性显示出显著的中到大效应：带摆臂反向跳 (ES = 1.84)、反向跳 (ES = 1.33)、深蹲跳 (ES = 1.17) 和立定跳远 (ES = 0.83)，≤ 10米直线冲刺时间 (ES = -1.12)，> 10米直线冲刺时间 (ES = -1.46)，以及变向重复冲刺能力。…

  • 水球运动中的运动营养补充与恢复：系统综述 [IF 5.8 (JCR 2024) · 营养学2区]
    Ergonutrition Supplementation and Recovery in Water Polo: A Systematic Review
    Nutrients · 2025

    一句话结论：Adequate ergogenic nutrition adapted to the needs of WP players is essential not only to optimize their athletic performance but also to ensure effective recovery and maintain their long-term health and general well-being.

    背景：水球（WP）是一项高强度团队运动，需要结合体能耐力、肌肉力量、速度和特定的技术技能。由于这项运动的严苛和长时间性质，充足和均衡的营养在运动员的表现、恢复和整体健康维护中起着基础性作用。目的：我们旨在汇编所有关于运动营养补充在水球运动员恢复中重要性的现有信息。这将有助于理解这项运动的特殊挑战和要求，使运动员和教练能够做出明智的营养决策。…

    European journal of medical research · 2025

    一句话结论：Post-traumatic degradation of peripheral sensorimotor feedback following ankle injury induces central nervous system-mediated motor control reorganization, resulting in altered movement strategies that manifest through modified kinematic coordination patterns across the hip, knee, and ankle joints.

    Sports · 2023

    一句话结论：Compared to active controls, the load-equated CCT-2 and CCT3 programs provided similar effects on measures of physical fitness in active adult males, however, an athlete’s goal is to improve their MAT score, theCCT-3 program may elicit greater improvements compared with the C CT-2 program.

    Muscle synergy characteristics of pumping in Chinese elite windsurfers

    Medicine & Science in Sports & Exercise · 2026
